user.title: Connect to the CX-5 controller
user.description: Use the controller's address on the WireGuard tunnel. Use a key with the "control" role, not an admin key: Home Assistant stores it unencrypted.

data.private_key: Private key (PEM), leave empty to create one

enroll.title: Enroll this key on the controller
enroll.description:
Home Assistant created a key. On the controller's admin page, under "Add a key", enter id **{key_id}**, role **control**, and this public key, then press Submit here:

`{public_key}`

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the saved key. Enter a current key.

error.invalid_fingerprint: That is not a SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex characters, colons allowed).
error.invalid_key: That is not a valid P-256 private key in PEM format.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Is the tunnel up, and is the car awake?
error.pin_mismatch: The controller's certificate does not match that fingerprint.
error.invalid_auth: The controller does not accept that key.
error.not_enrolled: The controller does not know this key yet. Add it on the admin page, then submit again.

abort.already_configured: That controller is already set up.

resync.name: Resync tracked state
resync.description: Tell the controller what the car really shows, without pressing anything.
